\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and verbs — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R160-first-pass-describing-words-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to arrive and to live.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item proud, kind, cruel, ugly, beautiful
  \item strong, weak, alone, icy, clear
  \item cloudy, windy, to build, to climb, to go down
  \item to join, to visit, to sing, to paint, to lead
  \item to make, to carry, to put on, to take off, to clean
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Proud? (\textbf{superbus, superba, superbum}.) Kind? (\textbf{benignus, benigna, benignum}.) Cruel? (\textbf{crūdēlis, crūdēle}.) Ugly? (\textbf{turpis, turpe}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{fōrmōsus, fōrmōsa, fōrmōsum}.) Strong? (\textbf{validus, valida, validum}.) Weak? (\textbf{īnfirmus, īnfirma, īnfirmum}.) Alone? (\textbf{sōlus, sōla, sōlum}.) Icy? (\textbf{gelidus, gelida, gelidum}.) Clear? (\textbf{serēnus, serēna, serēnum}.) Cloudy? (\textbf{nūbilus, nūbila, nūbilum}.) Windy? (\textbf{ventōsus, ventōsa, ventōsum}.) To build? (\textbf{aedificō, aedificāre}.) To climb? (\textbf{ascendō, ascendere}.) To go down? (\textbf{dēscendō, dēscendere}.) To join? (\textbf{iungō, iungere}.) To visit? (\textbf{vīsitō, vīsitāre}.) To sing? (\textbf{cantō, cantāre}.) To paint? (\textbf{pingō, pingere}.) To lead? (\textbf{dūcō, dūcere}.) To make? (\textbf{faciō, facere}.) To carry? (\textbf{gerō, gerere}.) To put on? (\textbf{induō, induere}.) To take off? (\textbf{exuō, exuere}.) To clean? (\textbf{pūrgō, pūrgāre}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R160-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to break and to throw.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to break, to throw, to carry, to carry, to untie
  \item to give back, to show, to shine, to lose, to win
  \item to grow, to hurry, to stay awake, to dine, to taste
  \item to feel, to hang, to be silent, to keep, to change
  \item to count, to destroy, to go away, to arrive, to live
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To break? (\textbf{frangō, frangere}.) To throw? (\textbf{iaciō, iacere}.) To carry? (\textbf{vehō, vehere}.) To carry? (\textbf{portō, portāre}.) To untie? (\textbf{solvō, solvere}.) To give back? (\textbf{reddō, reddere}.) To show? (\textbf{ostendō, ostendere}.) To shine? (\textbf{lūceō, lūcēre}.) To lose? (\textbf{perdō, perdere}.) To win? (\textbf{vincō, vincere}.) To grow? (\textbf{crēscō, crēscere}.) To hurry? (\textbf{festīnō, festīnāre}.) To stay awake? (\textbf{vigilō, vigilāre}.) To dine? (\textbf{cēnō, cēnāre}.) To taste? (\textbf{gustō, gustāre}.) To feel? (\textbf{sentiō, sentīre}.) To hang? (\textbf{pendeō, pendēre}.) To be silent? (\textbf{taceō, tacēre}.) To keep? (\textbf{servō, servāre}.) To change? (\textbf{mūtō, mūtāre}.) To count? (\textbf{numerō, numerāre}.) To destroy? (\textbf{dēleō, dēlēre}.) To go away? (\textbf{discēdō, discēdere}.) To arrive? (\textbf{adveniō, advenīre}.) To live? (\textbf{habitō, habitāre}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
